curl_stealth_config.description: Curl stealth headers and TLS flags for HTTP requests. Built as proper string format for curl command interpolation.

stealth_headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

curl_stealth_config.curl_tls_flags_string: -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" -H "Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8" -H "Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.5" -H "Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br" -H "Connection: keep-alive" -H "Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1"
curl_stealth_config.curl_tls_flags_compact: -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36" -H "Accept: */*" -H "Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.5" -H "Connection: keep-alive"
curl_stealth_config.usage_note: Use curl_tls_flags_string for full stealth or curl_tls_flags_compact for faster requests. Both are pre-built strings ready for f-string interpolation in curl commands.
